nr4a3_targets_chea.what: NR4A3 target genes from published ChIP-X experiments (ChEA). The matched term carries the source experiment's own PMID in its name, so the provenance of a membership call is checkable.
nr4a3_targets_chea.unresolved: ⚠ NOT RETRIEVED. This slot scored nothing. An absent set is an absent READING — it says nothing about the biology it names.

nr4a3_targets_encode_chea.what: NR4A3 consensus targets from ENCODE + ChEA ChIP-X.
nr4a3_targets_encode_chea.unresolved: ⚠ NOT RETRIEVED. This slot scored nothing. An absent set is an absent READING — it says nothing about the biology it names.

nr4a3_targets_trrust.what: NR4A3 targets from TRRUST v2, a manually curated literature-mined regulatory network — an instrument class independent of both ChIP and perturbation.
nr4a3_targets_trrust.unresolved: ⚠ NOT RETRIEVED. This slot scored nothing. An absent set is an absent READING — it says nothing about the biology it names.

nr4a3_perturbation_KD_DOWN.what: ⭐ THE FUNCTIONAL ARM. Genes DOWN when NR4A3 is knocked down / out — i.e. genes that DEPEND on NR4A3. If RET is in this set, RET abundance responds to NR4A3 loss, which occupancy alone cannot show.
nr4a3_perturbation_KD_DOWN.unresolved: ⚠ NOT RETRIEVED. This slot scored nothing. An absent set is an absent READING — it says nothing about the biology it names.

nr4a3_perturbation_OE_UP.what: Genes UP when NR4A3 is over-expressed — independently constructed, same expected direction as KD_DOWN, so agreement between them is worth more than either alone. ⭐ And it is the arm closest to EMC's own biology: the disease-defining event is NR4A3 sequence placed under a partner's promoter, i.e. over-expression.
nr4a3_perturbation_OE_UP.unresolved: ⚠ NOT RETRIEVED. This slot scored nothing. An absent set is an absent READING — it says nothing about the biology it names.

nr4a3_perturbation_KD_UP_CONTROL.what: ⛔ THE FALSIFIER, on the pattern read 3 already uses. Genes UP when NR4A3 is removed — the arm that should NOT track the other two. If it moves with them, the contrast is measuring something the sets share rather than NR4A3 output, and no membership call below may be quoted.
nr4a3_perturbation_KD_UP_CONTROL.unresolved: ⚠ NOT RETRIEVED. This slot scored nothing. An absent set is an absent READING — it says nothing about the biology it names.

nr4a1_targets_chea.what: NR4A1 targets from ChEA — the paralogue arm. A gene in ALL THREE paralogues' target sets is a family target, not an NR4A3 target, and that distinction is the whole of this repository's selectivity problem.
nr4a1_targets_chea.unresolved: ⚠ NOT RETRIEVED. This slot scored nothing. An absent set is an absent READING — it says nothing about the biology it names.

GSE24369_series_matrix.txt.gz.value_kind: single-channel intensity (an absolute level is interpretable only relative to this array's own probe distribution)

genome_wide_null._what: Welch t, EMC vs comparator, for EVERY symbol this platform's probes map to — the distribution a panel gene's own t has to be read against.
genome_wide_null._the_statistic_is_the_panel_s_own: probes averaged per symbol, standardised against that sample's whole-array background, Welch t. Identical arithmetic to `gene_reads`; see `self_check`.
genome_wide_null.\u26d4_this_is_not_a_multiplicity_correc: It reports WHERE a gene sits among all genes. It controls no error rate, and a high percentile is not a significance claim. Read it as the answer to 'is this t remarkable on this array', which is the question the phrase 'uncorrected for multiple testing' leaves open.
genome_wide_null.\u26a0_the_null_contains_real_signal: Genuine EMC-vs-comparator biology is inside this distribution — it is an observed distribution, not a permutation null — so a true signal's percentile is CONSERVATIVE rather than optimistic.
genome_wide_null.\u26a0_symbols_are_not_independent: Co-regulated transcripts move together, so the effective number of independent tests is far below `n_symbols_scored`.

background_reads_block._z_is: within-sample z over ALL probes on that array — the same reduction `gene_reads[...].per_sample.z_vs_array` and `signature_member_reads` report, positionally aligned to `gsms`. A null is a sample with no value for this gene's probe(s).
background_reads_block.sampling_frame: every symbol ANY probe on this array maps to, unfiltered — no expression, abundance or variance cut, and panel members NOT removed. Drawn from the full probe matrix at parse time, which is the only point where that frame exists (AUT-PD-178).
background_reads_block._n_drawn_also_wanted_means: how many of the drawn genes are also panel or curated genes. A background OVERLAPS the panels — that is expected and honest. A background CONTAINED IN them is not a background, and this field is how a consumer tells the two apart.

GSE4303-GPL3290_series_matrix.txt.gz.why: 10 EMC tumours against 3 DFSP and 3 GIST on the same two-colour cDNA print run. Probes carry EST accessions only, so the read depends on the accession->symbol bridge.

probe_symbol_mapping.ncbi_route: esearch(accession[ACCN]) -> nuccore UID; esummary(nuccore) -> caption so the UID can be tied back to its accession; elink(nuccore->gene); esummary(gene) -> symbol
probe_symbol_mapping.\u26a0_what_that_means: 12 consecutive elink chunks (1200 UIDs) returned no gene link at all, so the remaining 26067 were not queried. This is a reading about the ENDPOINT, not about the accessions: it says NCBI stopped answering, and it does NOT mean those accessions have no gene. The resolution rate below is a floor.
